fields.customer_persona: Customer priorities and intended use have not been supplied. Present the reviewed options without assuming personal requirements.
fields.decision_frame: Compare engine and equipment choices against the customer's stated requirements. Fuel efficiency, service costs and local availability remain unconfirmed.
fields.takeaway: The Hyundai CRETA has three engine choices and six standard airbags; other equipment depends on the trim.
fields.primary_outcome: Compare approved engine and gearbox options, including their variant conditions.
supporting_outcomes: Review the seating layout and listed cabin equipment
Review standard airbags and the trim conditions for driver assistance
fields.do_not_recommend_if: Do not infer suitability before the customer's requirements are known. The approved seating capacity is five; requirements beyond the available evidence need confirmation.
fields.advance: Use Contact Dealer to confirm the configuration, availability and a written quotation, then arrange a test drive.
fields.notes: The overview describes the five-door compact SUV and introduces variant differences, supported by F033 and F038. Customer priorities remain unknown until stated.
